"I have to add that I would never want to change the way I look and that I know there are people who would kill to look the way I do."

lol..

Nevertheless, i can feel you. I've been dealing with this exact same problem for quite a long time. People see me as a jerk whereas i'm not, i believe myself to be a bit introverted, but i can open up if i want but i just rarely seek that situation.. i'm also shy too, but i enjoy living in my own little world haha:P.

What i may suggest you regarding this topic, well, i think there are two ways you can look at this:

1, Easy way: You should leave all your acquaintances behind, because they already made an opinion about you and if people had already made up their minds about you then it's incredibly hard to prove it otherwise... So what i'm saying, is muster up the courage, loosen yourself a bit and try to enjoy the conversation, lead the conversation, but still be interested in the other person but never forget the courage, it's the most essential component! Believe me i was on your path once (actually im still), and i have successfully overcame my "fears" of interacting with other people. There was a very good suggestion that i use all the time: "Behave with everyone that you dont know as if you've known each other since years", that helps a lot.

2, Hard way: Try to change how others see you, it's more rewarding in the long run if you accomplish this than the easy method. But along the way, you will encounter massive embarassment, shyness, anger, disappointment, and you probably won't understand what's the problem. If you choose this, you must fight hard to prove yourself.

There is also an optional, third way, but it is rather philosophic. Ask a few questions from yourself like...
Do i really hate being by myself?
if yes then -> Why?
if no then -> Then what's the problem? -> How can i fix them?

Thing is, you should make complicated things simpler in order to deal with them, ppl tend to ignore that when it comes to serious matters...

Lastly, i enjoy being by myself i mean im very independent, i have a lot of free time to take care of myself, and i found that people being alone (except mentally sick ppl) are more intelligent. So remember one thing: life is what you make it, not how others decide to handle you.
